# Axios

> > Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for Node.js and browsers, providing a simple API for making XMLHttpRequests and handling responses.

Axios is an open-source JavaScript library that simplifies HTTP requests with features like interceptors, automatic JSON transformation, and comprehensive error handling. It works seamlessly in both browser and Node.js environments.

## Key Topics

- HTTP client
- Promise-based
- Node.js
- Browser compatibility
- XMLHttpRequest
- API requests
- Request configuration
- Response interceptors
- Error handling
- HTTP methods
- Method aliases
- JavaScript library
- Open source
- Axios API
- HTTP status codes
